item.title: Top Resurrection Sunday Songs You Must Listen To This Year
item.description: Resurrection Sunday is the perfect time to reflect and rejoice, and these top songs capture the powerful message of hope and renewal. From timeless classics to fresh anthems, these tracks will uplift your spirit and celebrate the triumph of Christ's resurrection.

item.title: Hospital Staff Rally to Help Couple Say ‘I Do’ Amid Bride’s Rare Cancer Diagnosis
item.description: When a bride receives a devastating rare cancer diagnosis, hospital staff step in to make her dream wedding possible. In a powerful act of compassion, they transform a medical space into a place of love, allowing the couple to say “I do” against all odds.

item.title: 16 Easter Quotes - Bible Verses and Famous Quotes about Easter
item.description: Find some of the best quotes about Easter from the Bible and famous Christians throughout history.

item.title: 55 Children Singing 'Risen' By Shawna Edwards Embodies The Easter Spirit Beautifully
item.description: A powerful new Easter song, 'Risen', by Shawna Edwards, features the angelic voices of 55 children from the One Voice Children's Choir, proclaiming Jesus' sacrifice and message of hope. The heartwarming music video showcases the innocence and purity of childhood as they sing about our risen Lord, making it a perfect accompaniment to your Easter celebrations.

item.title: Crossing Guard Goes the Extra Mile and Helps Child Across Flooded Waters
item.description: When floodwaters made it dangerous for a child to get home, a caring crossing guard stepped in without hesitation. Going above and beyond, they ensured the child made it across safely, showing true everyday heroism.

item.title: Dogwood Tree Legend Tells The Story Of Jesus' Crucifixion
item.description: The Dogwood tree, a symbol of Easter and Christianity, is said to have been used to build Jesus' cross, leading to its promise that it would never again grow large enough to be used for such a purpose. The tree's unique characteristics, including the cross-shaped flower and crown of thorns, are believed by some to be reminders of this legend, offering a poignant reminder of the sacrifice made by Jesus on the cross.

item.title: A 1929 Firefighter’s Heroic Rescue Still Connects Two Families Generations Later
item.description: A heroic rescue by a firefighter in 1929 didn’t just save a life—it created a lasting bond between two families. Generations later, that act of bravery continues to connect them in a powerful and meaningful way.

item.title: 18-Year-Old Climber Survives a 260-Foot Fall Down a Mountain Against All Odds
item.description: An 18-year-old climber survived a terrifying 260-foot fall down a mountain, defying the odds in a remarkable way. His survival is a powerful story of resilience, strength, and what many are calling a miracle.

item.title: Built Different or Just Prepared
item.description: Following a grueling, ill-prepared hike to the top of Half Dome, this reflection explores how a single bag of Funions, some beef jerky and a struggle with comparison mirrored the spiritual life. It serves as a reminder that faithfulness isn't measured by someone else's pace, but by staying nourished through a consistent dependence on God.

item.title: After More Than 40 Years as Neighbors, a Senior Couple Says Yes to Forever
item.description: After more than 40 years of living side by side, a senior couple realized their lifelong friendship had grown into something more. Their decision to say “yes” to forever proves love can blossom at any stage of life.
